name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: Switches between related panels of content in the same place, one visible at a time.

examples.name: tabs-demo
examples.title: Tabs
examples.description: Underline tabs for switching sections of a page.

examples.name: tabs-pill
examples.title: Pill
examples.description: A segmented control for switching views of the same data.

examples.name: tabs-with-counts
examples.title: Icons, counts and disabled
examples.description: Leading icons, a count after the label, and a disabled tab that arrow keys skip.

examples.name: tabs-vertical
examples.title: Vertical
examples.description: Tabs stacked beside the panel, e.g. for settings.

props.name: variant
props.description: underline: a 2px indicator under the selected tab. pill: a segmented control on a sunken track.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Vertical puts the tab list beside the panel and uses ↑/↓ to move.

props.name: defaultSelectedKey
props.description: The initially selected tab's id (uncontrolled). Defaults to the first enabled tab.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Called when the selected tab changes.

props.name: keyboardActivation
props.description: manual: arrow keys move focus only; Enter/Space selects. Use when showing a panel is slow.

props.name: disabledKeys
props.description: Ids of tabs that can't be selected.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the tab list (or use aria-labelledby).

props.name: children
props.description: Tab elements, or a render function with items.

props.name: id
props.description: Matches the TabPanel with the same id.

props.name: count
props.description: A small count after the label; part of the tab's accessible name.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Makes the tab unselectable; arrow keys skip it.

props.name: href
props.description: Renders the tab as a link, for tabs that change the URL (pair with a router).

props.name: id
props.description: Matches the Tab with the same id.

props.name: shouldForceMount
props.description: Keeps the panel in the DOM while another tab is selected (inert and display: none), so its state survives switching.

keyboard.action: Moves focus into the tab list (to the selected tab), then to the panel.
Moves to the next / previous tab and selects it (mirrored in right-to-left). Wraps around; skips disabled tabs.
Moves to the first / last tab.
Selects the focused tab when keyboardActivation is manual.

notes: role="tablist" / "tab" / "tabpanel" with aria-selected, aria-controls and aria-labelledby wired by React Aria.
The selected tab is shown by an indicator (underline) or raised surface (pill) plus text colour and weight — not colour alone.
Overflowing tabs scroll inside the list; the focused tab scrolls into view. Underline tabs draw an inset focus ring because the list clips outside it.
The panel is focusable when it has no focusable content, so keyboard users can reach it.

do: Use short, parallel labels (one or two words).
Use underline tabs for sections of a page and pill tabs for switching views of the same data.
Give the TabList an aria-label that says what the tabs switch between.
With server components, render Tabs, TabList and Tab from a client component ('use client'), or set defaultSelectedKey. Panel contents can still come from the server.
dont: Don't use tabs for steps in a sequence — use Steps.
Don't use tabs for site navigation between pages unless each Tab has an href.
Don't render Tabs straight from a server component without defaultSelectedKey. The server can render no selected tab, and the page then fails hydration.

typeNotes.note: Key is React Aria's Key: string | number. React's Key also allows bigint, so state typed with it fails the check. Import Key from @strata/react instead: import { type Key } from '@strata/react'. String ids work too.
